📖 How to use

  1. Pick the start and end dates.
  2. Tick the business-days option to count Mon–Fri too.
  3. Read the years/months/days breakdown and totals.
  4. Business days exclude Saturdays and Sundays only.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the breakdown computed?

The years/months/days breakdown walks the calendar forward from the start date (clamping the day to each month's length), so it matches how calendars actually work. Total days is the exact day count including leap days.

What counts as a business day?

Business days count Monday-to-Friday only, excluding Saturdays and Sundays. Public holidays are not excluded — only weekends.

Does the order of the dates matter?

Yes — the order is normalized automatically, so the result is always the positive duration between the two dates.
